entries.title: Coupled Double Pendulum Chain
entries.description: A row of 10 pendulums hangs from a light beam, each bob connected to its neighbors by springs so that when one is displaced the oscillations transfer and spread along the chain with trails and energy meters displayed.
entries.seed: Coupled Double Pendulum Chain: A row of 10 pendulums hangs from a light beam, each bob connected to its neighbors by springs so that when one is displaced the oscillations transfer and spread along the chain with trails and energy meters displayed.

entries.title: Chaotic Double Pendulum Explorer
entries.description: A transparent support rod holds a classic double pendulum with colored arms and a glowing bob that leaves a 3D trail, while on-screen labels show angle, angular velocity, and energy as the motion shifts from periodic to chaotic.
entries.seed: Chaotic Double Pendulum Explorer: A transparent support rod holds a classic double pendulum with colored arms and a glowing bob that leaves a 3D trail, while on-screen labels show angle, angular velocity, and energy as the motion shifts from periodic to chaotic.

entries.title: Foucault Pendulum over Rotating Globe
entries.description: A long pendulum with a heavy bob swings over a lightly textured Earth sphere that slowly rotates, with the bob’s path marking a precessing trace on a circular floor dial marked with compass directions.
entries.seed: Foucault Pendulum over Rotating Globe: A long pendulum with a heavy bob swings over a lightly textured Earth sphere that slowly rotates, with the bob’s path marking a precessing trace on a circular floor dial marked with compass directions.

entries.title: Pendulum Wave Art Installation
entries.description: Twenty pendulums of increasing length are aligned along a horizontal beam so they swing in and out of mesmerizing wave patterns, each bob glowing a different pastel color and leaving faint fading trails.
entries.seed: Pendulum Wave Art Installation: Twenty pendulums of increasing length are aligned along a horizontal beam so they swing in and out of mesmerizing wave patterns, each bob glowing a different pastel color and leaving faint fading trails.

entries.title: Mass–Spring–Pendulum Hybrid
entries.description: A mass hangs from a spring that itself is attached to a pivot, so the mass can both bounce vertically and swing like a pendulum, with arrows showing forces and color changes indicating stretching and compression.
entries.seed: Mass–Spring–Pendulum Hybrid: A mass hangs from a spring that itself is attached to a pivot, so the mass can both bounce vertically and swing like a pendulum, with arrows showing forces and color changes indicating stretching and compression.

entries.title: Driven Damped Pendulum with Torque Motor
entries.description: A single pendulum is attached to a motorized pivot that applies a sinusoidal torque; the bob swings in 3D while a small dial and arrow at the pivot show driving phase, and a semi-transparent “air” field applies damping.

entries.title: Newton’s Cradle with Flexible Strings
entries.description: A 3D Newton’s cradle features five metallic spheres on visible strings; collisions transfer momentum and cause bouncing and slight swinging out of plane, with impact flashes and tiny sound-wave-like particle ripples.

entries.title: Pendulum Clock Mechanism
entries.description: A pendulum swings beneath a transparent casing, engaging an escapement mechanism that ticks a gear train driving clock hands on a dial, with moving teeth, collisions between pallets and gear, and labels for key components.

entries.title: Spherical Pendulum in a Gravitational Well
